email.body1:
Kourosh, saw Laurel close its $100M Series C, grow ARR 300 percent, and land firmwide at McDonald Hopkins.

Momentum like that usually means more co-sell and partner-sourced accounts in play than the ecosystem can cover at scale, and that is where partner pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Laurel's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Partner-sourced pipeline usually stalls on coverage: there are far more co-sell targets across the legal, accounting, and consulting ecosystem than the team can personally work, so your best plays never get the volume they deserve and partner-sourced number lands short.

email.body3:
Kourosh, last bit of proof for Laurel.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner motion? I will tailor it to Laurel either way.
